data.long_meaning: Nooran is a beautiful Arabic name meaning 'radiant' or 'full of light'. It symbolizes purity, hope, and spiritual illumination, reflecting brightness both inside and out. The name Nooran carries the meaning “Radiant, Full of Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Nooran usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, full of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine light and guidance, symbolizing clarity, purity, and enlightenment.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nooran total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نوران
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوران اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے نورانیہ، روشنائی، یا روشنی۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ نورانیت کی خصوصیت والے فرد کے لئے یہ نام روایتی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_urdu.name: نوران
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوران ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'نور' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی یا روشنائی۔ یہ نام اسلامی دنیا میں بڑی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اکثر اس کی وجہ سے اختیار کیا جاتا ہے کہ یہ روشنی اور ہدایت کی علامت ہے۔ اس نام کے افراد کو روشن خیال اور مثالی شخصیت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नूरान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरान एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है नूरानी, प्रकाश या रोशनी। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत मायने रखता है और अक्सर बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है क्योंकि यह ज्ञान और सच्चाई की ओर इशारा करता है। नूरान नाम के व्यक्ति को बुद्धिमान और उच्च आदर्शों वाला माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نوران
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوران دى يو ښکلى نوم دى چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوى دى. دى نوم د روښنايي او نور په معنا دى. په اسلامي کلتور کې دا نوم ډېر اهميت لرى او د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې د روشن او پرهېزگار شخصيت لري.

in_english.name: Nooran
in_english.long_meaning: Nooran is a meaningful name derived from the Arabic root 'nūr', meaning radiant, luminous, or shining. This name has deep roots in Islamic tradition and is often associated with light, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment. Historically, the term 'nūr' is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic theology. The name Nooran symbolizes a person who brings light and positivity to those around them.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Nooran represents the light of God that resides within every human being. It's a reminder that just as a light bulb casts its light to illuminate a room, every individual is here to spread the light of love, kindness, and compassion to the world around them. The name also represents the idea that within each one of us lies the potential for greatness and illumination, encouraging the pursuit of knowledge and personal growth towards self-enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nooran: Light of the Beloved. A name symbolizing the inner radiance and illumination that emanates from a deep connection to the Divine. In the heart of Nooran, the light of God shines bright, guiding the way through life's journey.
